evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This will take about ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So you can walk away with the quote you can depend on instead of having a gas, would that be okay with you?
evidence_quotes.name_used: Rep asks for Nala at open, then uses Nyla throughout (slight spelling variance but same name used repeatedly)
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked — rep moved directly into logistics probing
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No worry damage coverage included on the R-D way that you're paying us. We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move. And we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: A typical number of boxes based on your home size is 75 to 95 boxes. Do you feel that you follow within that range? And: do you need help in packing like putting kitchen was coding... is it only partial part packing or full packing?
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep went directly into address and property details without asking what items the customer was most concerned about
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep offered Saturday at 1:00 PM for walkthrough; move date is November 10th. Rep then stated: for the twin we can be able to back on the tenth or backed on the ninth and move on the tenth. No alternative days or dollar savings presented.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: So basically based on your home size, normally, we do a virtual walkthrough. In that way, we will just base it on the items that we are moving... I'll already text it to you a link for the virtual walkthrough on Saturday.

top_strength: Rep delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full terms disclosed, and successfully identified the need for a virtual walkthrough given the 1,800 sq ft home size, routing the call appropriately.
coaching_note: Ask the two-concerns question before starting logistics probing — it's the primary discovery opener on the v4 card and should land before address details, so you understand what matters most to this customer first.
